title: Cozy 3BR House with Garage
camera_locations: Outside the property (CCTV). No cameras inside.
house_rules: Check-in is from 3:00 pm to 6:00 pm. Please tell us your arrival time in advance.
Check-out is from 8:00 am to 11:00 am.
Guests must show a photo ID and a credit card at check-in.
Children over 13 are welcome. Guests 18 and older are charged as adults.
Guests under 18 can only check in with a parent or official guardian.
Cribs and extra beds aren't available.
No smoking inside. Smoking is allowed only in the designated outdoor area.
No parties or events, including bachelor/bachelorette parties.
Available for an extra charge: airport shuttle and babysitting.
description:
The entire 1,808 sq ft house is yours: a spacious, recently renovated three-bedroom home in a quiet residential neighborhood of Pittsburgh, with a private garage and driveway.

The home has three bedrooms (a king bed, a queen bed and a twin bed), plus a sofa bed in the living room, and sleeps up to 5 guests. There's a large living room with a sectional sofa and a flat-screen TV, a dining area, a full kitchen, one full bathroom and a washing machine. The house has air conditioning, heating and free Wi-Fi throughout.

Parking is easy: use the private garage or the driveway for free, with no reservation needed.

The home is close to Downtown Pittsburgh, local hospitals, universities, shopping, dining and major roadways. Frick Park, Regent Square and Edgewood Town Center are nearby, and Oakland, Shadyside, Squirrel Hill and the Strip District are an easy drive. Distances: Frick Park 3.4 mi, Chatham University 4.3 mi, Carnegie Mellon University and the Pittsburgh Zoo & PPG Aquarium 5 mi, Schenley Park, Phipps Conservatory and the Carnegie Museums 5 mi, Point State Park and the Andy Warhol Museum 9 mi. Pittsburgh International Airport is 22 mi away.

Your hosts are always available to answer questions and happy to share recommendations for local restaurants, attractions, shopping and hidden gems. The outside of the property is covered by CCTV, and the house has smoke alarms and a security alarm. An airport shuttle and babysitting are available for an extra charge.
